metadata.description: Three nested levels of orchestration for Claude Code: conductor (subagents in one chat), conductor-lint (plus a quality gate) and conductor-hq (sessions across days), with the agent-ledger and agent-lint mods.

plugins.name: conductor
plugins.description: Orchestration skill: rewrites your prompt as a technical brief, plans task cards, picks skills, agent and model per card, verifies and reports.

plugins.name: agent-ledger
plugins.description: Mod: /ledger pane with every agent, its model, status, tokens and cache share; last turn's tokens by model above the prompt.

plugins.name: conductor-lint
plugins.description: Conductor plus a lint layer: ESLint, line budgets per card, worker efficiency rules, agent-lint reports and one fix round.

plugins.name: agent-lint
plugins.description: Mod: ESLint for agent work. Reports what each worker left behind (TODOs, stubs, skipped tests, out-of-scope files, open issues, ESLint, line budget) to the conductor; /leftovers pane.

plugins.name: conductor-hq
plugins.description: Level 3: one HQ chat per project with its memory in HQ/ files; launches fresh worker sessions from briefs (code workers run conductor-lint), reviews their inbox reports, nothing posted or sent without approval.
